race.comment: PLEASE MIZTER (13) went back in trip off a short break last start and never featured when settling out the back. Now out to the mile again is a bonus and Tsang's claim means he carries no weight. Better for that effort and he's a two-time winner at the track and trip. Can improve quickly. GOLD ENIGMA (9) got a long way back last time, but it didn't matter as she got the job done in a photo finish. Can sit closer this time around and repeat the dose. I NEVER DREAMED (12) won well two back before a 1.8L defeat last time out in a similar performance. She remains down in te weights today and an inside draw looks ideal for her. Just needs the gaps to open up on straightening to make her presence felt. IDEALLY (5) is hard to knock on her recent form. Can spear across from out wide and be in this for a long way. GIBRALTAR GOLD (7) can go to another level now third-up into the campaign.
